static.label: Purpose
static.brief: What the system is for and what would stop if it did not run.

static.label: Users
static.brief: Who uses it, in what roles, and how they sign in.

static.label: Business process
static.brief: The business process it supports, in the order the work happens.

static.label: Tier and criticality
static.brief: How critical it is, and what depends on it.

static.label: Owners
static.brief: Who owns it and who knows it best.

static.label: Context diagram
static.brief: The system, the systems and people around it, and what passes between them.

entity.label: Interface
entity.brief: One interface: what it connects to, the protocol and direction, how often, who is on the other side, and where its address is configured.

entity.label: Batch job
entity.brief: One scheduled job: when it runs, what it runs, what it needs first, whether it can be re-run, and what to do when it fails.

static.label: Start of day
static.brief: What is checked or done at the start of the working day.

static.label: End of day
static.brief: What happens at the end of the day, in order, and how to tell it worked.

static.label: Failure handling
static.brief: For each way the nightly or daily work fails: the symptom, the cause, and the step that fixes it.

static.label: Restart and recovery
static.brief: Where a failed run is restarted from, and what must not be re-run.

static.label: Escalation
static.brief: Who to call, in what order, in and out of hours.

entity.label: Known error
entity.brief: One recurring problem: how it shows, why it happens, how it is fixed or worked around, and how often it has happened.

static.label: Environments
static.brief: The environments there are, and what differs between them.

static.label: Access groups
static.brief: Who has access, through which groups or accounts.

static.label: Contacts
static.brief: People and teams to contact, for what, and how.

static.label: Open questions closed
static.brief: Every question the evidence could not answer has an answer from a person.
